import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static int totalK;
    static long totalN;

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] mat = new int[33][33];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= totalK; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= totalK; j++) {
                    mat[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static Matrix identityMatrix = new Matrix();
    static Matrix[] matrices = new Matrix[70];
    static Matrix finalResult = new Matrix();
    static Matrix[] prefixMatrices = new Matrix[70];
    static Matrix[] suffixMatrices = new Matrix[70];

    static void printMatrix(Matrix m) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= totalK; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= totalK; j++) {
                System.out.print(m.mat[i][j] + " ");
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
        System.out.println();
    }

    static Matrix matrixMultiply(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
        Matrix c = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= totalK; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= totalK; j++) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k <= totalK; k++) {
                    long val = ((long) a.mat[i][k] * b.mat[k][j]) % MOD;
                    sum = (sum + val) % MOD;
                }
                c.mat[i][j] = (int) sum;
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    static void preparePrefixSuffix() {
        prefixMatrices[0] = matrices[0];
        for (int i = 1; i < totalK; i++) {
            prefixMatrices[i] = matrixMultiply(prefixMatrices[i - 1], matrices[i]);
        }
        suffixMatrices[totalK - 1] = matrices[totalK - 1];
        for (int i = totalK - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            suffixMatrices[i] = matrixMultiply(matrices[i], suffixMatrices[i + 1]);
        }
        matrices[0] = suffixMatrices[0];
        for (int i = 1; i < totalK; i++) {
            matrices[i] = matrixMultiply(suffixMatrices[i], prefixMatrices[i - 1]);
        }
    }

    static void execute() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        totalN = sc.nextLong();
        totalK = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize identity matrix
        for (int i = 0; i <= totalK; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= totalK; j++) {
                identityMatrix.mat[i][j] = 0;
            }
            identityMatrix.mat[i][i] = 1;
        }

        finalResult = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= totalK; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= totalK; j++) {
                finalResult.mat[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        finalResult.mat[totalK][totalK] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < totalK; i++) {
            matrices[i] = new Matrix();
            for (int j = 0; j <= totalK; j++) {
                matrices[i].mat[j][j] = 1;
                matrices[i].mat[j][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        while (totalN > 0) {
            int rem = (int) (totalN % totalK);
            if (rem != 0) {
                long tmp = totalN;
                long pos = 0;
                while (tmp > 0) {
                    tmp /= totalK;
                    pos = (pos + tmp) % totalK;
                }
                for (int i = rem - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    finalResult = matrixMultiply(matrices[(int)((pos + i) % totalK)], finalResult);
                }
            }
            preparePrefixSuffix();
            totalN /= totalK;
        }

        int res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < totalK; i++) {
            res = (res + finalResult.mat[totalK][i]) % (int) MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        execute();
    }
}
